I am much obliged for the Observer. I think your article is very well done & very interesting. I will send you a copy, as soon as I get one, of a paper which I have lately written, which it is possible, tho’ not probable, you might like to work up into a popular article

My health still keeps very weak, but I am able to do a little work on “Variation under Domestication”. The whole has been written once over & I am now going thro’ it again. I hope in 6 or 8 weeks to come to “Fowls” when I shall want my M.S. from you with any marginal corrections but I do not intend to add much on account of my weakness.
